name: volibear-noaurora-cards-race1-master-yi-01-pcq-mas
description: Best Volibear list against the Stuttgart RC Europe field if Dazzling Aurora is banned (Jeremy, 13 Nov 2026; an assumption, no ban announced then), by the card-level method: lists drawn around the starting lists, a regression of the win on the cards, then a race and a confirmation. Volibear piloted by spec_volibear_108_v0, each opponent by its own net, Ritualo's Dragons as the reference. Stage race1: 14 lists on the same seeds, 432 games per list shared out by the opponents' weights. This request: Master Yi (PCQ), 28 games.
